title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-10] Release ceremony
body:
## Outcome

Produce one release-ceremony receipt for the exact operator-approved milestone candidate.

## Primary deliverable

One release-ceremony receipt binding the approved candidate, notes, tag, and release identity.

## Verification result

Live readback proves the notes, tag, and release resolve to the exact approved candidate and operator authorization.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one release-ceremony receipt; preparation and asynchronous bookkeeping are external inputs or follow-up work.

## Dependencies

- TAIL-09: #525

## Retained predecessor scope

- #189

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All prior tail issues have reviewed-green ancestral merges
- [ ] Notes tag and release bind the exact candidate
- [ ] Operator authorization is retained

## Owned paths

- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/release/tail-10/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/RELEASE_NOTES_v0.92.1.md`

## PVF lanes

- `tail-merge-census`
- `tag-and-release-readback`
- `notes-parity`

## Stop conditions

- Operator authorization is absent
- Any prior tail issue lacks a reviewed-green ancestral merge

## Non-goals

- Unreviewed merge
- Administrative finish or cleanup
- Post-release feature work
